raw_text: OSINT monitoring detected farmer convoy assembly at multiple Punjab border points before any mainstream media coverage. Telegram groups shared detailed logistics including convoy staging areas, supply distribution points every 10 km, medical team locations, and barricade bypass routes. The level of operational coordination mirrors military logistics planning.
